prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Use the same login method as before to restore your existing pets and progress."]
1: []
2: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Choose a preset pet or design a custom companion that lives right on your desktop.", "Get Started"]
3: ["Pet generation usually takes around 2-3 minutes. You can safely minimize this window."]
4: ["Choose a starter companion style"]
5: ["We're preparing your pet!"]
6: ["What kind of companion do you need today?", "Answer 2 quick questions to find your matching desktop companion vibe.", "Select your ideal pet energy"]
7: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, customize, or open settings. Drag with your mouse to move them around your screen."]
8: ["Essential Desktop Shortcuts", "Right-click pet: Menu & Settings | Drag: Move pet | Double-click: Interact", "Start Playing", "Quick Controls Overview"]
9: ["Upload Photos & Claim Free Starter Scarf", "Your uploaded photo unlocks an exclusive custom color theme for your pet's first accessory."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos and offers a free gift extra as an incentive.
